summary: Which platforms and editors does v0.1.0 support?

resolution.gist: v0.1.0 supports VS Code 1.105+ on macOS and Linux (including WSL as the documented route for Windows), best-effort native Windows, does not block forks, and requires Claude Code ≥2.1.139 and Node ≥22.18.
